build_omniglot_dataset_builder: build an Omniglot dataset builder using TensorFlow Datasets for one-shot learning with 1623 handwritten characters
create_omniglot_split_generators: create split generators for train, test, small1, and small2 splits from downloaded Omniglot archives
summarize_omniglot_info: summarize the Omniglot dataset info including image shape, alphabet labels, and 1623 character classes
test_walk_omniglot_dir: test the _walk_omniglot_dir function to yield examples with alphabet, character id, label, and image path
review_get_names: review the _get_names function to union alphabet and label names across all Omniglot directories
